The '''subcommittee on mineral taxation''' was a committee in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] in [[44 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Luewet Wuul]] served as [[Chairman/Legends|chairman]] of the committee.
